beats.say: Ah... ah... I need to sneeze!
I'll put the tissue on my antenna!
The tissue goes over your nose and mouth!
Okay! I'll wave it up high!
Sneeze into a tissue, then throw it away.
No tissue? Use your elbow, not your hands!
Can you do a pretend elbow sneeze?

sources.fact: Cover your mouth and nose with a tissue when you cough or sneeze; throw used tissues in the trash; if you don't have a tissue, cough or sneeze into your elbow, not your hands; wash your hands after
